questions.q: How do fuzzy bumblebees warm up on a chilly morning?
questions.fact: They shiver! Bumblebees buzz their wing muscles without flapping to heat up, so they can fly on cool days.

questions.q: Which bumblebees make it through the winter?
questions.fact: Only the new queens! They sleep underground all winter and start a brand new colony in spring.

questions.q: Which garden food do bumblebees help by buzzing to shake pollen loose?
questions.fact: Tomatoes! Bumblebees grab the flower and vibrate, called buzz pollination, to shake the pollen out.

questions.q: Where do many bumblebees build their nests?
choices: In old mouse holes in the ground
questions.fact: Old mouse holes! Many bumblebees nest in the ground, and their nests are much smaller than a honeybee hive.
